points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Original eight directories in immutable attempt297126a, not curated tip; report and figures are delivered. Structural validator outcome does not prove physical accuracy.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Historical evaluator reports official validator passed eight immutable-attempt cases plus report; fresh clean build succeeds but CTest has no tests.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Reported residual targets reached and Re200 force history is periodic; steady stop tests only residual, and physical accuracy remains limited by high drag and mostly first-order updates.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M015 lam Cd3.187, M080 lam0.692 and Re20 Cd4.701 are markedly above same-case peers despite bounded tails; comparisons are qualitative, not external exact errors.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Actual case residual, force, surface and computed-field panels are embedded; Re200 late drag compressed by startup. Re20 Mach plot exactly reproduces from original field.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Readable 16-page report discloses steady fallback and case values, but Re200 late drag is unreadable and large force anomalies have limited critical analysis.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Original report manifests/fields and force histories are in immutable attempt; one Re20 Mach image reproduced pixel-identically, while other image bindings and exact executable remain qualified.
